status: implemented from public source and demo measurements; native visual validation pending

body_css.typography: --font-size-small .8125rem, mini .75rem, regular .9375rem, title3 1.25rem; normal 450, medium 500, semibold 600; body line-height 1.5. Desktop UI uses the small size; editor regular text remains a separate role.
body_css.header: ContentViewHeader Q8.header adds thinPixel to mainHeaderHeight = 44 - thinPixel. Use the resulting 44 logical px for the main header, consistent with the inspected Linear 1.32.4 All issues view.
body_css.color_limit: The CSS references injected sx variables. Its body does not contain resolved theme colors.

layout_source.values: kj.listIssueRowHeight 44, listHeaderHeight 36, mainPageMargin 8, mainContentBorderRadius 12, sidebarPadding 12, sidebarPrimaryButtonSize 28. mainHeaderHeight 44-thinPixel is a separate override, not the common header default.

sidebar_source.values: Q.prototype.sidebarWidth defaults to 244; normal bounds 192 to 330. WorkbenchSidebar rows are 28 high with 1px vertical margins and radius 8. Common controls use radius 6.

shell_colors.scope: Public startup shell, not authenticated theme output

primary_and_elevated_source.formula: controlPrimary = accent. i = base[0] > 50; s = (i ? -1 : 1) * (min(contrast,30) + max(contrast-30,0)*0.25) / 30. Hover adds (i ? 6 : 5)*s to L and 2*s to C. Label uses getTextColor(accent), L = accent[0]-accent[1]*0.075 > 65 ? 0 : 100, C = min(5,accent[1]), and the accent hue.
primary_and_elevated_source.conversion: CIE LCH D50 to Lab, XYZ D50 with white [.3457/.3585,1,.2958/.3585], Bradford adaptation to D65, then standard sRGB transfer. Clamp encoded channels to [0,1] and round floor(channel*255+0.5). The source label exceeds sRGB blue and is clipped to #fffeff. Bundle code was read, not executed.
primary_and_elevated_source.contrast_adjustment: UltraTasks preserves the 4.5:1 text minimum. Only failing source backgrounds reduce L in 0.001 steps, keeping C and hue fixed, until their rounded 8-bit pair passes. These are accessibility adjustments, not unmodified Linear colors.
primary_and_elevated_source.active_projection: GPUI primary_active and button_primary_active reuse action_hover. A distinct pressed color was not established from the captured generator.
primary_and_elevated_source.surface: FastCreate uses elevatedTheme.bgBase. Dialog and popover surfaces use that base. Parent inspected the installed Linear 1.32.4 All issues and Create dialog. Native UltraTasks render validation remains pending.

adaptations: Normal app font weights 450/500/600 take precedence over demo weights 510/590. Title line height and tracking use the measured demo.

Dark hover and selection are demo white overlays composited in sRGB over shell canvas #121213 and rounded to 8-bit opaque #171718 and #1b1b1c. These are derived values, not resolved main-app theme values.

Light text, hover and selection retain existing Radix Slate values pending resolved main-app theme evidence. Elevated surfaces and primary actions use the captured theme generator with the sRGB conversion and contrast adjustments recorded above.
Keyboard focus uses the neutral muted color at 1px. This remains an UltraTasks adaptation, not a claimed Linear color measurement.
Feedback colors retain existing Radix pairs. OS high contrast overrides every surface, including sidebar, with OS colors.

font.windows: Static TTF faces at 400, 500, 600 and 700. GPUI 0.3.11 DirectWrite selects a matching face by weight and calls CreateFontFace without explicit variable axis values. Requested 450 may select a nearby static weight; exact raster parity is unverified.

motion_proposal.reduced_motion: Omit movement interpolation; preserve immediate state feedback.
